packsize.note: When gramasi is a numeric size, packsize = '<gramasi> <satuan>' (e.g. '50 gr', '40 ml'); holds on 5214/6506 rows. When gramasi is a non-numeric literal such as 'Set' or 'Multi Variant', packsize equals gramasi verbatim and satuan carries the same literal. For bundle_type='multipack', packsize = '<gramasi> <satuan> x <int(bundle_quantity)> pcs' (e.g. '10 gr x 2 pcs').

sku_type_complete.note: Holds on 6471/6506 rows. sub_brand already carries the brand prefix (e.g. 'Amura Ageless Ultra Day Cream'), so brand is NOT concatenated again. For bundle_type='set', packsize is the literal 'Set' and sub_brand already ends in 'Set', so sku_type_complete == sub_brand with no suffix appended.

keywords.note: keywords is a verbatim copy of sku_type_complete in 6235/6506 (95.8%) of existing rows.
